svg.title: N1
svg.desc: Schematic electropherogram reconstructed from called allele identifiers and RFU heights. Horizontal called-peak positions use nominal kit display coordinates, not measured fragment sizes or asserted exact GeneMapper bin centres.
svg.text: Kit: AmpFlSTR NGM PCR Amplification Kit (Applied Biosystems / Life Technologies) · nominal coordinate model 0.4-ngm1 · called peaks: 32
Schematic reconstruction: only peaks called in the GeneMapper genotype export are shown. No baseline, uncalled artefacts or additional stutter peaks are generated.
Horizontal called-peak positions use nominal kit display coordinates, not measured fragment sizes or asserted exact GeneMapper bin centres.
